facts.text: I am working with a mock census dataset generated in Python using the Faker package.
The mock census dataset is designed to emulate the format of the 1881 census of the UK.
The dataset includes fields for Street Number, Street Name, First Name, Surname, Age, Relationship to the Head of House, Marital Status, Gender, Occupation, Infirmity, and Religion.
In the dataset, Street Number is set to "1" if it is a unique dwelling.
In the dataset, Relationship to the Head of House can be any person aged over 18, and the Head is the person responsible for filling in the census details.
In the dataset, Marital Status values are Single, Married, Divorced, Widowed, or "NA" for minors.
In the dataset, Gender values are Male or Female, and other responses were not implemented in 1881.
In the dataset, Occupation is implemented in a modern style rather than typical 1881 occupations.
In the dataset, Infirmity uses a limited set of infirmities following the style of 1881.
In the dataset, Religion uses a set of real-world religions.
I need to clean the dataset because it has missing entries and some responses that are outright lies.
Part of the grading for the assignment assesses the cleaning details.
The town in the census is modestly sized and is sandwiched between two much larger cities connected by motorways.
The town does not have a university, but students live in the town and commute to nearby cities.
After cleaning, I must decide what should be built on an unoccupied plot of land the local government wishes to develop.
One development choice is high-density housing if the population is significantly expanding.
One development choice is low-density housing if the population is affluent and there is demand for large family housing.
One development choice is a train station to take pressure off the roads by serving commuters.
One development choice is a religious building, considering demand for a second Church for Catholics or a different denomination or religious building.
One development choice is an emergency medical building (a minor injuries centre) if there are many injuries or likely future pregnancies.
I can also choose "Something else" as a development option.
I must justify whichever development choice I make using the data provided and argue it is a priority against other choices.

events.text: Assignment task: clean the mock census dataset and decide a development priority for an unoccupied plot of land using the provided data.
